# Vivo Johari — community API

**Generated from the running route table. Do not edit by hand — edit the
`doc({...})` beside each route in the Vivo loyalty backend and it will be
rewritten.**

Base URL: `https://community.vivofashiongroup.com/api/community`
(the frontend calls it root-relative as `/api/community`, so it works in dev too).

## How auth works

Sign-in is by **phone number**, and the session is a **bearer token**, not a
cookie. `POST /auth/verify` returns `token`; send it on every guarded call as:

    Authorization: Bearer <token>

The token is the same session the Vivo loyalty app issues — a community member
IS a loyalty member, with one account, one points wallet and one membership
barcode. There is no separate community identity to create or keep in step.

## Errors

Failures come back as `{ error, message, detail }`. **Read `detail`** — the
client was written against a FastAPI backend and that is the field it renders.
`detail` is usually a string; where the UI needs to act on the reason it is an
object, e.g. a taken handle returns
`detail: { code: "username_taken", message, suggestions: [] }`.

## A note on the member object

`member.points` is a **number** (spendable points) and `member.tier` is a
**string** (`Tsavorite` | `Ruby` | `Tanzanite`). The richer shapes are beside
them as `points_detail` and `tier_detail` — the scalars are what the screens
render, and swapping them for objects prints `[object Object] pts`.

## Endpoints

### `POST /api/community/auth/logout`

Exists so the call does not 404. The session is a stateless JWT the client holds; drop it.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None |
| **Send** | — |
| **Returns** | { ok: true } |

### `POST /api/community/auth/request-code`

Send a one-time code to a phone number. Any format; matched on the last 9 digits.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None |
| **Send** | `{ phone: string }` |
| **Returns** | { ok: true, demo: boolean, phone_masked: string } — `demo` true means SMS is not sent and the fixed demo code signs in. |

### `POST /api/community/auth/signup`

Create the account behind a verified number.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None |
| **Send** | `{ signup_token, full_name, username, email, dob?, consent, notify?, referral_code?, terms_version? }` |
| **Returns** | { token, member }. 409 with detail.code="username_taken" and detail.suggestions[] when the handle is gone. |

### `GET /api/community/auth/username-check`

Is a handle free? Called while typing on the signup screen, before a session exists.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None |
| **Send** | `?u=<handle>` |
| **Returns** | { available, valid, message, suggestions[] } |

### `POST /api/community/auth/verify`

Exchange the code for a session, or for a signup token when the number is new.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None |
| **Send** | `{ phone: string, code: string }` |
| **Returns** | { token, member } for an existing member; { needs_signup: true, signup_token } otherwise. The token is a bearer JWT — send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. |

### `GET /api/community/me`

The signed-in member.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer token required |
| **Send** | — |
| **Returns** | { member } — points is a NUMBER (spendable), tier a STRING (Tsavorite|Ruby|Tanzanite); points_detail and tier_detail carry the full shapes. |

### `PUT /api/community/me/settings`

Change handle, public tier/leaderboard visibility, or notification consent.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer token required |
| **Send** | `{ username?, show_tier?, show_leaderboard?, notify? }` |
| **Returns** | { member } |

### `GET /api/community/push/key`

The VAPID public key a browser needs to subscribe. Safe to expose — it is public.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None |
| **Send** | — |
| **Returns** | { enabled: boolean, publicKey: string } — enabled false means push is not configured; do not prompt. |

### `POST /api/community/push/subscribe`

Register this device. Upserts on endpoint, so re-registering is safe.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer token required |
| **Send** | `PushSubscription.toJSON(): { endpoint, keys: { p256dh, auth } }` |
| **Returns** | { subscribed: true } |

### `POST /api/community/push/test`

Send a test notification to every device this member has registered.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer token required |
| **Send** | — |
| **Returns** | { sent: number } — how many devices accepted it. |

### `POST /api/community/push/unsubscribe`

Forget this device. Call it alongside the browser's own unsubscribe.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer token required |
| **Send** | `{ endpoint: string }` |
| **Returns** | { unsubscribed: true } |
